# eBay

> > eBay is a global marketplace for buying and selling electronics, collectibles, fashion, vehicles, and more with live shopping features and personalized account management.

eBay serves as a comprehensive e-commerce platform offering millions of products across diverse categories including electronics, automobiles, fashion, collectibles, and specialty items. The platform emphasizes security, user verification, and personalized shopping experiences through features like My eBay, watchlists, saved searches, and daily deals.

## Key Topics

- marketplace
- e-commerce
- live shopping
- account security
- identity verification
- fraud prevention
- user authentication
- My eBay
- watchlist
- daily deals
- collectibles
- electronics
- fashion
- vehicles
- gift cards

## Core Marketplace

- [Electronics, Cars, Fashion, Collectibles & More | eBay](https://www.ebay.com): eBay homepage: marketplace for electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles with live shopping
- [Daily Deals on eBay | Best deals and Free Shipping](https://www.ebay.com/deals): eBay daily deals page with discounted products and free shipping offers
- [eBay Gift Cards | eBay.com](https://www.ebay.com/giftcards): eBay gift cards product page with redemption and FAQ information

## Account & Personal Shopping

- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mys/home): eBay My eBay account home page with identity verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/summary): eBay My eBay account summary with security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/watchlist): eBay My eBay watchlist page with security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): eBay My eBay bids and offers page with security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/purchase): eBay My eBay purchase history page with fraud prevention security
- [eBay Home](https://www.ebay.com/mye/buyagain): eBay Buy Again feature for replenishment shopping and product recommendations

## Saved Items & Preferences

- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/saved): eBay My eBay saved items page with security verification
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/mye/myebay/savedsearches): eBay My eBay saved searches page with account access verification

## Specialized Shopping

- [My Garage | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/g/mygarage): eBay My Garage: vehicle-specific parts, accessories, and DIY guides
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://ppcapp.ebay.com/myppc/wallet/list): eBay wallet page for seller payments and account verification

## Authentication & Security

- [Security Measure | eBay](https://signin.ebay.com/ws/eBayISAPI.dll): eBay login security verification and identity confirmation page
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://signup.ebay.com/pa/crte): eBay account creation with security verification and fraud prevention
- [Security Measure | eBay](https://www.ebay.com/help/home): eBay help center with security verification and user support resources
